changelog.title: Changelog
changelog.subtitle: Last 5 releases
v240: Added multi-language support (PL, EN, DE, IT)
Added Metric (mm) / Imperial (inch, SFM) unit switcher
v230: New modules: retaining ring grooves (DIN 471/472), parallel keys (DIN 6885), O-ring grooves (ISO 3601)
New theoretical surface roughness Ra/Rz calculator
v220: Smart comma and dot handling in numeric fields
v210: Added geometry module: drill cone and edge chamfering
Extended ISO tolerance database and DIN 509 undercuts
v200: New dark interface and full PWA support (offline mode)
Material weight module and hardness converter
